library(DBI)
library(RSQLite)
con <- dbConnect(SQLite(), "our.db")
df_oi <- dbReadTable(con, "order_item")
df_o <- dbReadTable(con, "order")
df_pr <- dbReadTable(con, "product")
dbDisconnect(con)
library(dplyr)
df <- df_oi %>%
  left_join(df_o %>% select(id, created_at), by
            = c("order_id" = "id")) %>%
  left_join(df_pr %>% select(id, price, name), by
            = c("product_id" = "id")) %>%
  mutate(created_at = as.POSIXct(created_at,tz="UTC"),
         revenue = quantity * price,
         product_id = factor(product_id))
library(ggplot2)
df$day <- as.Date(df$created_at,tz="UTC")
df$product_id <- factor(df$product_id)
df <- df[order(df$product_id, df$day), ]
date_lim <- range(df$day, na.rm = TRUE)
if (date_lim[1] == date_lim[2]) date_lim <- date_lim + c(-3, 3)
lab <- df %>% distinct(product_id, name) %>% arrange(product_id)
# below is decomposition of the graph
# below is the second graph - customers / foot traffic
library(lubridate)
mx = 0
mx_date = ""
df$day <- as.Date(df$day)
for (i in 1:nrow(df)) {
  #print(df[i, ])
  year <- as.integer(format(df$day[i], '%Y'))
  month <- as.integer(format(df$day[i], '%m'))
  day <- as.integer(format(df$day[i], '%d'))
  days = year * 365 + month * 30 + day
  if (mx < days) {
    mx <- days
    mx_date <- df$day[i]
  }
}
if (!require("devtools")) install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("mkuhn/dict")
library(dict)
qs <- dict()
for (i in 1:nrow(df)) {
  year <- as.integer(format(df$day[i], '%Y'))
  month <- as.integer(format(df$day[i], '%m'))
  day <- as.integer(format(df$day[i], '%d'))
  days = year * 365 + month * 30 + day
  if (days >= mx-6) {
    q <- as.integer(df$quantity[i])
    p_id <- as.character(df$product_id[i])
    if (is.null(qs[[p_id]])) qs[[p_id]] <- 0
    qs[[p_id]] <- qs[[p_id]] + q
  }
}
options(repos = c(CRAN = "http://cran.us.r-project.org"))

#install.packages("varhandle")
library(varhandle)
total <- 0
segs <- data.frame(
  mx_date = as.Date(character()),
  lr = numeric(),
  rr = numeric(),
  col = integer()
)
for (key in names(qs)) {
  if (check.numeric(key)) {
    # product id
    print(df_pr$name[as.integer(key)])
    #print(qs[[key]])
    # average daily quantity
    # will use week sum and make a range for
    # next week
    
    # maybe round it instead of as.integer
    l <- round(qs[[key]]*0.833)
    r <- round(qs[[key]]*1.2)
    lr <- (l / 7) * as.numeric(df_pr$price[as.integer(key)])
    rr <- (r / 7) * as.numeric(df_pr$price[as.integer(key)])
    total <- total + as.integer(qs[[key]]) * as.numeric(df_pr$price[as.integer(key)])
    print("The quantity for next week for this product id will range from l to r:")
    print(l)
    print(r)
    print(lr)
    print(rr)
    print(as.integer(key))
    segs <- rbind(segs, data.frame(
      mx_date = mx_date,
      lr = lr,
      rr = rr,
      col = as.integer(key)
    ))
  }
  #value <- as.numeric(qs$get(key,0)) / 7
  #print("Key")
  #print(key)
  #print("Value")
  #print(value)
}
library(ggnewscale)

segs$mx_date <- as.Date(segs$mx_date)
curr_plot <- ggplot(df, aes(x = day, y = revenue, color = product_id, group = product_id)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  scale_x_date(limits = date_lim) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = range(0, max(df$revenue))) +
  scale_color_discrete(
    name = "Product",
    breaks = lab$product_id,
    labels = lab$name
  ) +
  ggnewscale::new_scale_color() +
  geom_segment(
    data = segs,
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    aes(x = mx_date, xend = mx_date, y = lr, yend = rr, color = col),
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  scale_color_identity(guide = "none")
curr_plot
print("Total projected revenue for next week:")
print(total)
